content.text: We need to see if nuisance overrides x0. Compute hidden activations: h_i = ReLU(w_i·x + b). We need class1 iff x0>0 regardless x1. Check if any hidden unit depends on x1 and influences output to override. Let's compute contributions: For each hidden unit, weight vector: unit0: [-1,0]; unit1: [0,-1]; unit2: [1,0]; unit3: [0,1]. So units 0 and2 depend on x0; units1 and3 on x1. Output weights: for class0: [1,-4,4,-1]; class1: [-1,4,-4,1]. So contributions from x1 units: unit1 weight -4 to class0, 4 to class1. unit3 weight -1 to class0, 1 to class1. So x1 can affect difference. We want class1 if x0>0. Let's analyze: Suppose x0>0, x1 arbitrary. Hidden: unit0: ReLU(-x0)=0; unit2: ReLU(x0)=x0. unit1: ReLU(-x1)=0 if x1>=0 else -x1? Wait ReLU(-x1) = max(0,-x1). So if x1<0, unit1 = -x1 >0. unit3: ReLU(x1)=max(0,x1). So outputs: For class0: 1*0 + (-4)*h1 +4*h2 +(-1)*h3 = -4h1 +4h2 -h3. For class1: -1*0 +4*h1 -4*h2 +1*h3 = 4h1 -4h2 + h3. Difference d = class1 - class0 = (4h1 -4h2 + h3) - (-4h1 +4h2 -h3)=8h1 -8h2 +2h3. Simplify: d=2(4h1 -4h2 + h3). We want d>0 when x0>0. h2 = x0>0. h1 depends on x1 negative. h3 depends on x1 positive.
